title: Enforcer Helmet
summary: An unobtainable helmet that heals the wearer for 1d6 after a knockout.

fields.Rejuvenating Takedown: Restore 1d6 HP when you knock a creature unconscious.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Dammon’s recorded stock quantity is zero.
